revision_summary: Two minor timestamp drifts (06:46→06:44 and 06:53→06:57 for the booking-lock quotes) should be corrected on rerun — words are accurate, just off by 2-4 seconds, so these are minor fixes not fabrications. More substantively: (1) fix the schema misuse in cherry_pick_moments — 'button_up.no_driving_at_computer' is a phone-appointment-specific item and doesn't apply to this in-person home visit booking; recite the general button_up appointment-description requirement instead. (2) fix the schema misuse citing 'coaching_philosophy.energy_match' for the halting-speech moment at 07:19 — that section governs pace/tempo matching, not verbal confidence/fluency; reclassify under knowledge_gap_handling. (3) Relabel the invented classification tag 'prior_contact_probe_miss' at 01:41 to something schema-aligned like 'co_owner_clarification_gap' tied to verify.title_co_owners. (4) Add the two missed moments: the customer re-asking the rep's name at 07:50 (supports the legitimacy/anchoring weakness thread already built) and the customer's surprise at 08:01 that a different specialist — not Carter — will show up (a second, later instance of the same expectation-setting gap pattern already flagged at 06:14, worth extending in the trajectory_verdict and handoff_brief). (5) Soften the severity framing on the intro_legitimacy_omission moment — customer never signals legitimacy suspicion anywhere in the call, so the 6-second gap between name/company and form-reference should be framed as a low-cost stylistic note, not bordering on a legitimacy failure. All other quotes, the core trajectory read (efficient-but-fragile booking, unused ROI/incentive-skepticism flip, empathy miss on foot surgery), and the outcome classification (booked, correctly unflagged for dispute) are well-grounded and should be retained as-is.
